title: PDF Master original-to-Rust feature parity inventory
scope: Source-backed product capabilities and visible workflows. This is an inventory, not a claim that legacy tests were rerun or that the Rust candidate has full parity.

status_definitions.original.available: Implemented, routed into the original native product, and backed by a focused contract or workflow source.
status_definitions.original.partial: The original ToolCatalog or implementation explicitly presents a bounded subset.
status_definitions.original.conditional: Implemented but requires a provider key, account, network, or another explicit runtime condition.
status_definitions.original.unavailable: The original product explicitly disables this catalog entry; it is not required for replica parity unless scope changes.
status_definitions.rust.partial: Some foundation behavior exists, but the original workflow, platform acceptance, or both are incomplete.
status_definitions.rust.unsupported: No user workflow equivalent exists in the current Rust candidate.
status_definitions.rust.complete: Reserved for implemented behavior with linked automated evidence and cross-platform human acceptance; unused in this inventory.

legacy_contracts.meaning: Legacy XCTest identifiers carried as pending traceability rows, not a UX inventory and not Rust parity proof.

features.title: 批注工具入口
features.gap: Bounded Text notes and independent Square/Circle/Line annotations are exposed, including plain/single/double arrows and preserving imported ten standard line endings and bounded dashes during resize. Shapes have numeric selection/update and epoch/bytes-bound native deletion with COW popup links. Ink adds bounded independent annotations, shared midpoint smoothing, pointer capture and native edit guards; raw input is not crash-persisted. Ink selection/style changes/eraser, highlight, underline, strikeout, stamp, page selection/dragging, extended styles/relationships and current-feature platform acceptance remain incomplete.
features.next_slice: Complete persistent editor state, Ink lifecycle and page-hit/drag placement, then markup and broader styles with actual three-platform acceptance.

features.title: 内容编辑入口
features.gap: Rust exposes bounded ASCII AddText only; native text/image/link replacement, deletion, styles, and drag editing are absent.
features.next_slice: Add inspected text selection and Unicode-safe replace/delete with atomic save/reopen tests.

features.title: 签署 PDF

features.title: 填写表单

features.title: 评论 PDF
features.gap: Bounded Unicode Text note creation/list/edit and native-confirmed undoable deletion exist; popup COW preserves other pages. Tagged annotations, incoming/outgoing replies, ambiguous shared popups, duplicate-root plus popup and direct reverse-popup updates fail closed; relationship scan is capped at 16384 entries. Editor input persistence, page-click selection, popup display, cross-page navigation, broader compatibility and current-feature platform GUI acceptance remain absent. Changes are not secure erasure.
features.next_slice: Validate note edit/delete/cancel/export/reopen across platforms, persist editor input and extend tagged/threaded annotation lifecycle.

features.title: 管理页面

features.next_slice: Build page overview with multi-selection, drag reorder and transactional PDF insertion; accept extraction on target GUIs.

features.title: 压缩 PDF

features.title: 合并 PDF

Reorderable merge UI, broader tagged/widget/global-color/layer/language migration and three-platform GUI acceptance remain pending; not unrestricted merge or secure erasure.
features.next_slice: Accept batch insertion on each target, add user-controlled ordering and extend document relationships without silently discarding them.

features.title: 绘图
features.gap: Numeric Square/Circle/Line creation/list/update/native-confirmed deletion has independent appearances, COW relationships, RGB stroke/optional fill, atomic undo and extraction/insertion preservation. Plain/single/double arrow creation, 0.25–32pt inclusive line widths, reverse direction, ten standard ending styles and bounded BS/legacy Border dashes persist on resize. Appearance bounds expand to avoid clipping thicker lines; page-edge clipping remains. Source coordinates stay unrotated. New pointer Ink uses shared midpoint smoothing, quarter-turn CSS coordinates, frozen style, per-stroke undo, native epoch/bytes guards, bounded RPC/request cancellation and staged image recovery. Uncommitted samples are not crash-persisted; unapplied shape parameters are not close-guarded. Ink selection/update/eraser, canvas dragging, alpha/caption/leader/measurement styles and current-feature three-platform GUI acceptance remain incomplete.
features.next_slice: Complete persistent editor state, Ink lifecycle and page-hit/drag placement, then markup and broader styles with actual three-platform acceptance.

features.title: Dirty close/quit protection

features.title: Open normal and password-protected PDFs

features.title: Page rendering and navigation

features.title: Search, text selection, and result navigation
features.gap: Bounded current-session Unicode text search, case option, result navigation and direct page jump exist; glyph selection/highlight, cross-page matching, complex-font compatibility and full platform acceptance remain absent.
features.next_slice: Add audited glyph geometry and selection/highlight with bounded page indexes.

features.title: Zoom, fit, layout, rotation-aware viewing
features.gap: Rust has manual/preset zoom, rotation-aware fit width/page and an original-derived three-group toolbar with mode strips/context panels. Continuous/two-page layouts, exact icons, full original interaction and accepted native responsiveness remain incomplete; narrow-window rows are an explicit adaptation. See UI-PARITY.md.
features.next_slice: Accept actual toolbar/fit behavior on target platforms, then port layout model and platform input routing.

features.title: Thumbnail page overview and reorder

features.next_slice: Implement virtualized thumbnails and transactional reorder selection.

features.title: Expert keyboard and menu commands

features.next_slice: Define a platform-neutral command model before binding native menus.

features.title: Save, Save As, and external-change protection

features.next_slice: Implement destination identity/adoption and external revision guards while retaining no-clobber exports.

features.title: Transactional undo/redo and dirty revisions

features.title: Page clipboard and batch operations
features.gap: Rust supports adjacent move, duplicate/blank and single-PDF insertion, one-transaction range rotate/delete, native snapshot-bound deletion confirmation and range extraction through native save/readback without acknowledging source dirty/recovery state. Clipboard carrier, paste, multi-file merge, richer multi-selection, tagged/widgets, excluded-page link policy and target GUI acceptance remain incomplete; extraction is not secure erasure.
features.next_slice: Add validated clipboard carrier and multi-file merge, preserving resource/annotation relationships; accept insertion/extraction on each target platform.

features.title: Annotation create/select/edit/delete/sidebar
features.gap: Bounded Text note and rectangle/ellipse numeric lifecycle supports current-page lists, snapshot/epoch-bound deletion and COW popup links. Document-wide read-only annotation sidebar excludes Widget/Link/Popup and preserves page/object/slot identity, Unicode contents, basic device colors and validated dates, with page/newest sorting, page navigation and guarded clipboard summaries. Supported annotation creation/updates now write real UTC modification dates; Undo/Redo preserve historical bytes. Rectangle navigation, selected-text excerpts, generic sidebar deletion, inferred default colors/ICC, tags/replies/ambiguous-popup lifecycle, persistent editor input, shape close guard, page-hit/drag selection, markup/Ink lifecycle/alpha and actual platform acceptance remain incomplete.
features.next_slice: Complete sidebar rectangle/excerpt/selection/delete interactions, persistent guarded editor inputs and page placement, then broader markup/relationships and actual three-platform UI acceptance.

next_slice_recommendation.title: Reader/search/save plus page overview before AI or canvas
next_slice_recommendation.rationale: The Rust foundation can open/render/edit/save a restricted PDF, but original daily document workflows still lack search/selection, adopted save semantics, thumbnails and transactional multi-page operations. These primitives also gate content editing and Copilot context.
exit_criteria: Generated unencrypted fixtures open, render, search, select, navigate, save/reopen, and retain page order without modifying the source unexpectedly.
Thumbnail reorder, insert PDF, extract, rotate, duplicate, and delete are transactional and undoable with invalid batches atomic.
Save/Save As/export distinguish adopted destinations, aliases, external changes, and no-clobber copies on macOS, Windows, and iOS-appropriate flows.
Platform GUI checks cover fit/layout, dirty close/system quit, write failure, and recovery; automated evidence remains separate from human acceptance.
explicitly_deferred: OCR, compression, page numbering, and broad conversion jobs
